item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che thig le dbyings chen g.yung drung sdom pa'i rgyud gsang ba don 'dus las gsang sngags bstan pa'i byung khungs bka' rgyud dpon gsas kyi lo rgyus
item.coloph: kho bo mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa'am/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal lam/ g.yung drung bdud 'dul thogs med rtsal gyis sum bsgrags bka' yi rgyas theb yongs su bkrol nas gtan la 'bebs par byas pa bgyis so//
